brain_proposals.general_rule: The covering-absorption directional tell (resting-bid / big-print over a sell-aggressor, or buyers absorbing under price) is NOT unconditional - its SIGN flips with rally EXTENSION. On a young / low-extension chain (cum_from_anchor low, chain age <=2) buyers-absorbing-a-dip = short-covering UP. On a maximally-extended multi-session covering rally (cum_from_anchor high ~>+2000 vs block anchor AND chain age >=5) the identical signature = late longs/chasers absorbed = DISTRIBUTION DOWN. Gate the tell on (extension state) x (realized flow_conviction); book polarity is never a standalone sign.
